items.statement: The torsional search spans the Z-to-E coordinate and advances a maximum to a separately optimized TS.
items.expected: A reported bounded scan/path from near the Z basin to near the E basin, with at least one maximum used as a TS candidate.

items.statement: The selected TS is a first-order saddle connected to E and Z.
items.expected: Exactly one imaginary mode with central C=C torsional character and a downhill/IRC connection to both endpoint basins in each environment.

items.statement: Gas-phase stationary-point energies and torsions reproduce the source result.
items.expected: E 0.00 eV/179.1 degrees; TS 1.43 eV/92.5 degrees; Z 0.23 eV/-4.5 degrees, relative to E.

items.statement: Acetonitrile stationary-point energies and torsions reproduce the source result.
items.expected: E 0.00 eV/179.0 degrees; TS 1.42 eV/92.5 degrees; Z 0.27 eV/-3.2 degrees, relative to E.
